findings.finding: H1 (Mar-Aug) profit will print far below last year's and is the worst progress rate in years. Q1 operating profit was -805m yen against +747m a year earlier (gross margin -0.6pt, about -1.6bn yen, from naphtha-driven materials costs and price promotions; SG&A 116.9%). The company's own monthly figures show Jun-Aug weaker than Q1: group existing-store sales 99.2% against 101.0% in Mar-May, customers 98.5%, and Kasumi's customers 95.6%. Last year's Q2 alone was -579m. H1 operating profit is therefore likely negative against +168m a year ago, against a FY plan of 10,000m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Next-session reactions on actual release dates (Yahoo closes): 2025-10-09 H1 (a small profit, plan held) -2.91%. 2026-07-06 Q1 operating loss +1.24% (the bad news was out). 2026-01-07 Q3 -1.12%. 2026-04-07 FY +0.11%. 2025-07-10 Q1 +0.33%. 2025-04-10 FY +4.09%. 2025-01-09 Q3 +1.64%. The last directly comparable visible-loss print (Q1, July 2026) rose.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: Q1 and the monthly series are both public, and the stock is -5.5% over 20 sessions and fell 1% on 10-08 when its peers printed. What is left is reaction risk: a 信用倍率 of 3.74 (crowded margin long) and peers that were still sold on weak H1s yesterday. If the miss were fully priced, peers would not have dropped 3% on prints that their own monthlies had also shown.
findings.independence: The monthly series is a different document: https://www.usmh.co.jp/ir/monthly_reports (Jun-Aug group existing-store sales 99.2%, customers 98.5%). Sector read-through: Fuji (8278, Aeon group, 15:00 on 10-08), H1 operating profit -49%, closed -3.1% (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8278&b=n202610080769). Life (8194, 11:30), H1 operating profit -6.4%, -3.1% (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8194&b=n202610080560).

findings.finding: The forecast decision is asymmetric in the stock's favour. The street already marks FY ordinary profit at 4.8bn yen, half the company's 9.6bn, so a cut to about consensus is not a disappointment and could read as the bad news being out (悪材料出尽くし). A hold is the likelier outcome: last year USMH held its plan at H1 and cut only in a separate notice on 2026-02-26, and its Aeon-group sibling Fuji held its plan yesterday at 14.6% H1 progress. A hold leaves the credibility gap where it is but adds no new negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance moves: 2026-02-26 standalone cut of FY2026/2 net profit to a loss, -4.07% that day and -3.50% the next (Yahoo closes). 2025-04-10 FY print with a growth plan +4.09% the next day. 2025-10-09 H1 with the plan held -2.91%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The consensus gap is public, which is why a cut to about 5bn should not hurt. What the price cannot hold yet is which branch the company takes. If the market expected a cut far below consensus, the stock would trade below its 850-yen consensus target with shorts building, and the register shows zero shorts with no change.
findings.independence: The hold-at-H1 habit comes from different documents: kabutan's revision history and news list (no H1 revision in Oct 2025; standalone cut 2026-02-26, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3222&b=k202602260014). The sibling hold comes from https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8278&b=k202610080006.

baseline_tension: Neutral positioning (no shorts, lean -0.009) and a -5.5% run-up already reflect sector weakness. The visible H1 miss is priced, and the strongest positive (a cut only to about consensus, or a hold with the bad news out, as after the Q1 loss print that rose 1.24%) roughly offsets the margin-long overhang. I looked for buybacks or dividend changes and found none signalled.
